configSubtitle: Web Login gear — pg_bridge + local/remote PostgreSQL
dbModeLocalHint: Queries use local PostgreSQL fields (like web Offline).
dbModeOnlineHint: Queries use remote/central PostgreSQL fields (like web Online).
networkPolicyOnlineHint: Always live bridge/PG. Errors when offline (no list cache fallback).
networkPolicyOfflineHint: AsyncStorage snapshots only + pending write queue.
networkPolicyHybridHint: Live PG when online (dbMode target); product/customer cache when offline. Queue syncs on reconnect.
connSyncSkipped: No live connection or sync already running.
localPgHint: Branch / bridge machine: usually 127.0.0.1 when PG is on the same PC as the bridge.
remotePgHint: Central or LAN PG — e.g. 192.168.1.80:5432 (bridge connects to this host).
moduleUnderDev: Placeholder native screen. Full workflow will match web in a later release.
androidEmulatorHint: On Android emulator, bridge host is usually 10.0.2.2 (PC localhost).
iosSimulatorHint: On iOS simulator, bridge host: localhost or Mac LAN IP.
physicalDeviceHint: On a physical phone, Bridge host = PC Wi‑Fi LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.10). Same network required.
pgHostFromBridgeHint: PG host is relative to the bridge PC, not the phone (use 127.0.0.1 if PG is on that PC).
noFirms: No firms found — check bridge settings
rtlRestartHint: You may need to restart the app for layout direction to fully apply.
